title: Position and Direction
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3; not yet checked by a Kenyan maths teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Outcomes a to d are KICD's words; e is attitudinal. Grade 3 moves along straight lines, tells right from left and turns right or left from a point; compass directions (north, east) come in Grade 4.

skills.key_step: The child marks the start and counts a step each time they land on a new place.

floor.question: Is a stretched string straight or curved?

board.do: Draw a path of 10 squares; a counter on square 3.

misconceptions.ask: Which way is 'back towards the gate'?
misconceptions.repair: Towards the gate: nearer the gate.
Yes: the path is not straight.

skills.key_step: The child uses the person's own right and left, imagining facing the same way.

floor.question: What is in front of you?

steps: Hold up the left hand: L.
Name what is on each side.
For someone else: face their way.
Then name their right and left.

board.do: Draw a child facing out of the page, a ball by one hand.

board.say: Is it the child's right or left?

board.do: The child turns to face the same way and predicts.

misconceptions.ask: If you turn to face the same way as Kamau, where is his right hand?
misconceptions.repair: On my right; facing me it is on my left.

misconceptions.ask: If you were the boy, where would your right be?
misconceptions.repair: On the left of the page as we look.

misconceptions.ask: Is the board in front or at the side?
misconceptions.repair: In front: look to the side.

checks.question: Facing the board, what is on your left?
A girl faces you with a bag in her right hand. Is the bag on your right or left?

skills.key_step: The child turns their body a quarter turn on the spot towards the named hand and says what they now face.
representations: a simple map of the school
steps: Turn on the spot to face it.

board.do: Draw a child facing the gate, office on the right.
The child draws an arrow for the turn.

misconceptions.ask: Which hand points to the office?
misconceptions.repair: The right: you face the office.

misconceptions.ask: Did you turn to the side or all the way back?

listen_for: the same as after the first turn
misconceptions.ask: After the first turn, where is your right now?

misconceptions.repair: To the left: you have turned.

checks.question: You face the gate and turn left. The field is on your left. What do you face?
Turn right twice from facing the board. What do you face?
